Displaying and Changing Installment Plans

To view or change existing installment agreements for a business partner, proceed as follows:

1. In the SAP Easy Access screen, choose |)Account

2. Choose Change or Display.

3. Specify the desired installment plan and choose Continue.

1 Note

Installment Plan >» Display 3 (transaction FPR3).

If you use the input help for the Installment Plan Number field, for selection using the installment plan history, the
system displays only active installment plans as standard. If you also want to display deactivated installment plans, you

have to specify a deactivation reason on the tab page Installment Plan History.
